text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] This [VB] trait Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a [VB] trait Digimon card in the hand. Then, that DNA digivolved Digimon may attack.

qa.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so you can choose their activation order.
qa.question:
I activate this card's inherited effect and DNA digivolve using two Digimon then attack with the digivolved Digimon.
